deviations.description: Requests that reference a missing structure (missing = 1) but trigger none of rules A, B, or C. The network has no dedicated missing-structure detector: the missing input only nudges the cov-cap, cord, and mandible units, so such requests are escalated only when they are already close to another rule's threshold (e.g. cap within roughly 5 Gy of cov). Typical requests, with cap well above cov, comfortable cord margin, and little mandible overlap, are sent to automated planning.
deviations.condition: (missing == 1) and (cov <= cap) and (cord_lim >= cord_floor) and not ((mand_in_ptv - 0.05 * ptv_vol > 0.1) and (cov > mand_lim))
